events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television, MTV, made its debut in 1981, forever changing the landscape of music and pop culture.

angles.name: MTV's Legacy
angles.copy: Remember the day music television changed forever? MTV launched on this date in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first video. What was your favourite music video from back in the day?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album, Definitely Maybe, in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Impact
angles.copy: It's been 32 years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British rock. What's your top track from this legendary album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in 1969, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Woodstock Remembered
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people gathered for three days of peace, love, and music at Woodstock. If you could have been there, which artist would you have wanted to see most?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The music world remembers Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977 at the age of 42. He would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Today marks 49 years since we lost the King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley. His music and legend live on. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: The hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was tragically shot in Las Vegas in 1996. He would have been 55 in 2026.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: 30 years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering Tupac Shakur, whose powerful lyrics and influence continue to resonate today.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away in 1970 at the age of 27. He would have been 84 in 2026.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Paying tribute to the incomparable Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon 56 years ago today. His guitar mastery remains unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Classic
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles delivered a masterpiece with 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. Which track is your favourite?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still delivering those powerful vocals. What's your favourite Pretenders song?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: You know the drill, it's Liam Gallagher's 54th birthday! Raise a glass to the one and only. What's your favourite Liam moment or lyric?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless second solo album, 'Imagine', in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Album Legacy
angles.copy: It's 55 years since John Lennon gave us the powerful and poignant 'Imagine' album. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: The First iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod – a device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. Did you get one of the early models? How did it change your music habits?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme songs, everyone has a favourite 007 moment. What's yours?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and enduring legacy of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us endless laughs. What's your favourite John Cleese character or sketch?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the "White Album," in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles unleashed their ambitious and experimental 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their diverse talents. What's your go-to track from it?
